differences.expected: the existing F11 command may already provide true graph fullscreen
differences.actual: F11 only toggles the Pinia zen flag and hides application chrome; it never invokes the Fullscreen API and GraphView has no fullscreen state
differences.correction: M6-1 adds a graph-scoped explicit toolbar action and keeps F11 zen semantics separate

differences.expected: community filtering may be a small base for collapse and expand
differences.actual: the real interaction is a 17 to 4 to 17 filtered-subgraph roundtrip with no proxy identity or aggregated-edge semantics
differences.correction: defer cluster proxies; M6-1 must not change nodes, edges, paths, evidence, history or export

differences.expected: Schema mode may be comparable in size because three structured editors already exist
differences.actual: all three editors lack provider trust, mapping, resolution, cache, offline/privacy and diagnostics-provenance contracts
differences.correction: defer Schema mode until a provider and association selection audit can be isolated

differences.expected: ODP presenter notes can follow the completed simple body-copy path
differences.actual: notes remain producer-asymmetric and are deliberately excluded from the accepted body edit transaction
differences.correction: keep notes read-only and do not broaden the v1.0.18 first slice
